name: Feature Plane Compression (CodecGS)
aliases: Compression of 3D Gaussian Splatting with Optimized Feature Planes and Standard Video Codecs
definition: Using feature planes (tri-plane architecture) to predict Gaussian attributes instead of storing them directly, compressed using video coding techniques.
summary: Feature Plane Compression (CodecGS) compresses 3D Gaussian Splatting by mapping attributes to learnable tri-planes, enabling efficient storage via standard video codecs.
